title: SLA-Safe Energy Control for AI-Native NG-RAN Using Stability-Aware Constrained PPO
abstract: arXiv:2609.05861v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: One important AI-for-RAN use case is energy saving, in which radio resources and cell energy modes must be dynamically controlled without violating user quality-of-service (QoS) or service-level agreement (SLA) requirements. However, aggressive sleep-state or deactivation decisions may reduce energy consumption at the cost of throughput degradation, delay increase, SLA violations, and unstable mode switching, especially under time-varying and bursty traffic conditions. This paper proposes a stability-aware constrained reinforcement learning framework for SLA-safe energy control in 5G NG-RAN. The problem is formulated as a constrained Markov decision process in which an AI-native controller selects closed-loop energy-saving actions based on cell load, queue status, active-user information, current energy mode, and SLA-related indicators. translated_title: 使用稳定性感知约束PPO的AI原生NG-RAN的SLA安全节能控制
translated_abstract: 一个重要的AI赋能无线接入网（AI-for-RAN）应用场景是节能，其中需要对无线资源和小区节能模式进行动态控制，同时不能违反用户服务质量（QoS）或服务等级协议（SLA）的要求。然而，激进的休眠状态或去激活决策可能会以吞吐量下降、延迟增加、SLA违规以及不稳定的模式切换为代价来降低能耗，尤其是在时变和突发的流量条件下。本文提出了一种面向5G NG-RAN中SLA安全节能控制的稳定性感知约束强化学习框架。该问题被建模为一个约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），其中AI原生控制器基于小区负载、队列状态、活跃用户信息、当前节能模式以及SLA相关指标来选择闭环节能动作。所提出的框架采用带自适应拉格朗日惩罚的约束近端策略优化（PPO）……
tldr: 本文提出一种基于稳定性感知约束PPO（带自适应拉格朗日惩罚）的强化学习框架，用于5G NG-RAN的SLA安全节能控制，在保障用户QoS和SLA的前提下动态优化小区节能模式切换。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a stability-aware constrained reinforcement learning framework using constrained PPO with adaptive Lagrangian penalties for SLA-safe energy control in 5G NG-RAN, dynamically optimizing cell energy mode switching while guaranteeing user QoS and SLA requirements.
